name: Race the Stream
summary: Race the stream is a automated racing game currently based on oval racing, all based around Twitch.tv where racers join using the !join command in chat to populate the grid, all cars have the same stats but each driver are issued random stats at race start and also randomly change during the race, slipstream also plays a big part in the racing, live leader board while race is in progress and a points system which only gets reset when the streamer chooses to. Day/Night cycle is in effect so you can race day or night or even set up a longer race and make it a entire day or more.
